title: Sybilla of Samus
summary: Raleigh names Sybilla of Samus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Sybilla of Samus, who according to Pausanias liued about this time. She is not the Sybilla who witnesseth of Titan and Saturne. The one-word title would fold onto sibyl, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
